decisions.reason: Grounds diagnosis in crash log stack (EntryGroup.update in cordis-plugin-loader, Include._apply) and both patch excerpts, identifying profile insert + bundle insert of workspace-files as the collision, with explicit fatal-not-last-write-wins semantics.

Full three-row safety matrix (config-by-id safe, insert of unshipped id safe, insert of shipped id fatal), classifies the manual row as the fatal third case, and cites the web-app-patch-excerpt.txt workspace-files row (L110-111) as evidence.
Prescribes deleting exactly the manual insert block (with its comments) from the profile cordis.patch.yml, leaving the bundle patch untouched; explicitly rejects plugin-code or bundle edits.
Explicitly states the plugin never loaded and no plugin-side change can resolve the boot failure, since the defect is profile-patch authoring/composition.

Both halves present: author-side grep of the installed web-app bundle cordis.patch.yml for the id before any hand insert, and a concrete host-side improved error naming both colliding sources and the row to delete.
